reason: Electron process plumbing: the main process starts and stops the coin-zcash utility process host. It lives outside src/renderer/families/, so the families contract cannot apply.
The preload only forwards the IPC channels listed in ZCASH_IPC, which comes from the coin-zcash contract. It imports constants only.
The renderer wraps the coin-zcash IPC client over the zcash bridge. It is reached only through the rspack alias from the lazy zcash chunk, so it costs nothing at startup.
Declares the ZcashBridge type of the same IPC channel. No rule reports it, since it imports no coin package.
Aliases the coin-zcash network entry to src/renderer/zcash.ts so the renderer reaches the utility process over IPC. Build tooling, not generic UI.
Legacy account-data migrations (evm, xrp, aptos, cosmos), versioned by array index: moving them risks the order. New coin migrations go to family code.
URL constants keyed by coin, accepted as data (decided 2026-11-23): no family branch and no coin import. A caller that picks an entry by testing a family or a currency id is a leak of that caller.
Developer demo of a DMK signer kit device action (SignerEthBuilder from device-signer-kit-ethereum), reached only from Settings > Developer.
The ldmkSolanaSigner, ldmkCosmosSigner, ldmkPolkadotSigner and ldmkTronSigner flags are sent as user properties. Their names are kept, and they go away with the flags.
